problems: The left end of the floor-rim dot row is hidden behind the white hydrangea bush in the foreground, so that edge reads shorter than it is.
The shelf dot row has a wide gap in the middle, under the porthole, so it reads as two short clusters rather than one continuous edge.
Below the bird's feathers a thin grey post shows instead of legs, so the bird looks propped on a stick.
posts.critique: The picture does what the caption says: the bird faces a tilted hut, and two rows of cyan dots clearly mark the shelf and the floor rim. The dots are small and partly covered, but you can still read them, and it is a calm, pleasant frame to show.
